headlines.description: — Cam Payne scored 13 of his 32 points in the fourth quarter, rookie VJ Edgecombe added 21 points in his return to the lineup and the Philadelphia 76ers rallied to beat the Memphis Grizzlies 139-129 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Payne, Edgecombe help 76ers rally to a 139-129 win over the Grizzlies

headlines.description: — Jalen Duren scored 26 points, Cade Cunningham had 21 points and 15 assists, and the Detroit Pistons snapped a season-worst four-game skid, beating the Brooklyn Nets 138-100 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pistons snap season-worst 4-game skid with 138-100 win over Nets

headlines.description: — Bam Adebayo scored 83 points, the second-best scoring effort in NBA history, to carry the Miami Heat to a 150-129 win over the Washington Wizards on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bam Adebayo scores 83 points, 2nd-best in NBA history, sets FT records in Heat win over Wizards

headlines.description: — Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 29 points, Jalen Johnson had 27 and the Atlanta Hawks won their seventh in a row, holding off the Dallas Mavericks 124-112 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alexander-Walker leads Hawks to 7th straight win, 124-112 over the tanking Mavericks

headlines.description: — Kevin Durant scored 29 points and Amen Thompson scored 23 points as the Houston Rockets beat the Toronto Raptors 113-99 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Durant, Thompson lead Rockets to 113-99 win over Raptors

headlines.description: — Devin Booker scored 27 points, Jalen Green had 25 and Royce O'Neale 21 as the Phoenix Suns pulled away in the fourth quarter to win a 129-114 shootout with the Milwaukee Bucks on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hot-shooting Suns have three 20-point scorers in 129-114 victory over Bucks

events.name: Boston Celtics at San Antonio Spurs

headlines.description: — Victor Wembanyama matched a career-high with eight 3-pointers, scoring 39 points and grabbing 11 rebounds and the San Antonio Spurs beat Boston 125-116 on Tuesday night to sweep a contentious two-game season series with the Celtics.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wembanyama powers Spurs through physical victory over Celtics, 125-116

events.name: Chicago Bulls at Golden State Warriors

headlines.description: — Matas Buzelis scored a career-high 41 points and hit a key 3-pointer with 2:20 left in overtime, Josh Giddey had a triple-double of 21 points, 17 assists and 13 rebounds, and the Chicago Bulls beat the undermanned Golden State Warriors 130-124 on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Buzelis scores career-high 41 points and hits key 3-pointer in overtime, Bulls beat Warriors 130-124

events.name: Charlotte Hornets at Portland Trail Blazers

headlines.description: — Brandon Miller had 21 points and eight rebounds, LaMelo Ball had 12 of his 14 points in the fourth quarter and the Charlotte Hornets overcame a 19-point deficit to beat the Portland Trail Blazers 103-101 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hornets rally for 103-101 victory over the Trail Blazers

headlines.description: — Devin Carter scored 22 of his career-best 24 points in the fourth quarter to power the Sacramento Kings to a 114-109 comeback win over the Indiana Pacers on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carter erupts for career-best 24 points to lead Kings to 114-109 comeback win over Pacers

events.name: Minnesota Timberwolves at Los Angeles Lakers

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic had 31 points, 11 assists and 11 rebounds in his seventh triple-double of the season, and the Los Angeles Lakers overcame LeBron James' latest injury absence to sweep their season series with the Minnesota Timberwolves with a 120-106...
headlines.shortLinkText: Luka's 31, Reaves' big 2nd half propel Lakers to season sweep of Timberwolves with 120-106 victory
